name: Ocfentanil
summary: Ocfentanil (INN; also called A-3217) is a potent synthetic opioid structurally related to fentanyl that was developed in the early 1990s as one of a series of potent naloxone-reversible opioids. The aim was to obtain an opioid with better therapeutic indices regarding cardiovascular effects and respiratory depression compared to fentanyl.

uses.text: Despite showing reasonable results in human clinical trials, Ocfentanil was never developed for medical use. One study suggests ocfentanil may be as effective as morphine in post-operative relief, and it has also been studied as a supplement to general anesthesia.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, including itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening.

summaryZh: 奧芬太尼也稱 A-3217，是一種在結構上與芬太尼相似的強效合成類阿片藥物。它在2015年被中國列為管控物質，在2018年2月被美國列為I類管控藥物。
summaryZhHans: 奥芬太尼也称 A-3217，是一种在结构上与芬太尼相似的强效合成类阿片药物。它在2015年被中国列为管控物质，在2018年2月被美国列为I类管控药物。

pharmacology.en: It is an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, the same target as fentanyl and morphine. Its effects can be reversed by naloxone.
pharmacology.zh: 它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑，與吩坦尼和嗎啡的作用目標相同，其作用可被納洛酮逆轉。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂，与吩坦尼和吗啡的作用目标相同，其作用可被纳洛酮逆转。

fact.en: Ocfentanil was made in the early 1990s as a hospital painkiller and tested in people, but it was never marketed, and years later it turned up as a street drug.
fact.zh: 奧芬太尼在 1990 年代初作為醫院止痛藥合成並進行人體試驗，但從未上市，多年後卻以街頭毒品的形式出現。
fact.zhHans: 奥芬太尼在 1990 年代初作为医院止痛药合成并进行人体试验，但从未上市，多年后却以街头毒品的形式出现。
